jobs.title: Software Developer (Python, C++)
jobs.description:
About The Company

The Boeing Company is a global leader in aerospace and defense, committed to innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We strive to make the world a better place by fostering an inclusive, respectful, and welcoming environment for every teammate. Our culture promotes professional growth and development, enabling employees to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of aviation and defense. Located in St. Charles, MO (St. Louis Area), the Phantom Works Weapons team is a hub of cutting-edge research and development focused on future weapons programs, including the Next Generation Cruise Missile program. Phantom Works is where imagination meets engineering excellence, delivering innovative solutions quickly through prototyping with an emphasis on safety, security, and reliability in demanding operational environments.

About The Role

The Boeing Company is seeking an experienced or senior Software Developer / Engineer to join the Phantom Works Weapons team. This role involves designing, developing, testing, and maintaining embedded software that supports advanced weapons systems. The successful candidate will work collaboratively across multiple stakeholders and programs to develop software solutions to complex challenges requiring both ingenuity and disciplined execution. This position requires an active U.S. Secret Security Clearance with the ability to obtain Top Secret and Special Program Access. Candidates should be comfortable working across multiple contracts and evolving development environments, with a strong desire to learn and apply new technologies. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects that shape next-generation defense capabilities.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Active U.S. Secret Security Clearance with the ability to obtain Top Secret and Special Program Access
Minimum 3 years of experience in C++, Python, and C# programming languages
Minimum 3 years of experience with Linux development environments
Experience with git or similar version control systems (3+ years)
Experience in software architecture development and open architectures (3+ years)
Experience with network architectures and software applications communicating over TCP/UDP-based networks (3+ years)
Preferred: 5+ years of related work experience or equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred: Active Top Secret/SCI clearance
Knowledge of host environments including processors, operating systems, and networks
Familiarity with software architecture and design methodologies
Understanding of software development processes compliant with industry and internal standards
Experience with software development and testing tools (compilers, debuggers, GUI builders, requirements management tools, etc.)
Knowledge of domains influencing software architecture, requirements, and integration, such as data processing and ground support systems
Understanding of implementation, validation, and verification processes to ensure software quality, performance, and safety

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software across the entire software lifecycle
Analyze and translate customer requirements into initial software design
Develop interface definitions and ensure effective integration
Perform unit and integration testing to validate software functionality
Participate in peer reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to standards
Support software system integration and testing activities
Create and maintain comprehensive software documentation
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions
Adapt to evolving development environments and technologies
Ensure compliance with safety, security, and regulatory standards

Benefits

Competitive base salary with variable compensation opportunities
Comprehensive health insurance plans
Flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
Retirement savings plans with company contributions
Life and disability insurance programs
Paid and unpaid time off for work-life balance
Relocation assistance based on candidate eligibility
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement
Drug-free workplace environment
Potential signing bonus for eligible external candidates

Equal Opportunity

Boeing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military or veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that respects and values all individuals.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Python Engineer - REMOTE
jobs.description:
Senior / Staff Python Engineer

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Python Engineer to join a rapidly growing SaaS company that is building next-generation, AI-driven platforms. In this role, you'll combine hands-on coding with technical leadership, mentoring other engineers and shaping the direction of complex, highly scalable systems.

You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Design, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, reliable, and performant features while fostering a culture of innovation and engineering excellence.

What You'll Do

Design and develop high-performance, scalable applications across Backend using Python 
Foster technical growth and continuous learning.
Define and implement system architecture to ensure long-term scalability and maintainability.
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across applications and infrastructure.
Champion best practices in testing, security, and deployment processes.
Partner closely with Product and DevOps in Agile development cycles to deliver impactful features.
Lead efforts to improve CI/CD pipelines and automation for faster, more reliable releases.
Maintain clear technical documentation to support long-term stability and scalability.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of software development experience
Strong expertise in Python and modern frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Django, etc.).
Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Familiarity with messaging and asynchronous systems such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar.
Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar).
Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and Git.
Experience implementing testing frameworks, code coverage, and quality standards.
Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Bonus: Experience with workflow orchestration tools or observability stacks.

What Success Looks Like

You deliver high-quality, reliable features that scale seamlessly with business growth.
Teams are mentored and aligned on technical best practices and processes.
The platform operates with high reliability, security, and performance.
Systems evolve gracefully to support future demands without compromising stability.

Compensation & Perks

Competitive salary: $170,000 - $200,000, plus potential equity.
Fully remote work environment (US-based).
Significant opportunity to own technical decisions and mentor other engineers.
Collaborative culture built on innovation, growth, and impact.

Benefits

Medical | Blue Cross Blue Shield

Multiple PPO plan options with nationwide coverage
100% in-network preventive care
Comprehensive coverage for doctor visits, prescriptions, and mental health

Dental | Guardian

100% coverage for preventive care
80-90% coverage for basic services
50-60% coverage for major services
Orthodontia benefit up to $2,000

Vision | Guardian VSP

$10 exam copay, $20 materials copay
$150 allowance for frames or contacts every 12 months

Life Insurance | Guardian

Company-paid life insurance of $50,000
for all full-time employees

Voluntary Life Insurance | Guardian

Option to purchase additional coverage for yourself, your spouse, and dependents
Spouse coverage up to 50% of employee amount, child coverage up to $10,000

401(k) Retirement Plan

Employer match of 50% of employee contributions, up to $2,350 per year

Immediate eligibility upon hire and full vesting from day one

Discretionary Paid Time Off (PTO)

Take time as needed to recharge and balance personal responsibilities
No fixed accrual - focused on results and trust

Paid Holidays

10 paid company holidays
annually, including major U.S. holidays and year-end break

jobs.title: Lab Assistant I - Sharp Tri-City - Night Shift - Per Diem
jobs.description:
Hours:

Shift Start Time:

Variable

Shift End Time:

Variable

AWS Hours Requirement:

8/40 - 8 Hour Shift

Additional Shift Information:

Weekend Requirements:

Every Other

On-Call Required:

No

Hourly Pay Range (Minimum - Midpoint - Maximum):

$29.710 - $29.710 - $32.690

This position is covered by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) with SEIU.

This position was originally posted to ratified STC SEUI CBA members from 11/3/26 - 11/11/26. The position is now available to be filled by internal candidates that are not members of the ratified Bargaining Unit or External candidates to Sharp.

What You Will Do

The primary functions of the Laboratory Assistant I are specimen collection, specimen handling and transport, specimen processing– including reference laboratory specimen processing and microbiology specimen processing clerical support, inventory monitoring, and assisting the Clinical Laboratory Scientist in the performance of automated, semi-automated and manual procedures in the clinical laboratory. 

Required Qualifications

Other Meets education requirements for California CPT Certification.
California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I (CPT I) Certificate - CA Department of Public Health; OR California Certified Phlebotomy Technician II (CPT II) Certificate - CA Department of Public Health -REQUIRED

Preferred Qualifications

Associate's Degree in life science courses or equivalent.
1 Year relevant work experience in a laboratory.
Minimum 6 months Phlebotomy experience.

Essential Functions

The position characteristics reflect the most important duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential functions of the job in a fully competent manner. They should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. The characteristics of the position and standards of performance may be changed by TCMC with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization. Maintains a safe, clean working environment, including unit based safety and infection control requirements. Perform specimen collections, includes venipuncture and capillary sticks. Process specimens received in the laboratory. This task includes specimen transport, handling, sorting, requisition entry, distribution of specimens to all laboratory sections. Centrifuge and aliquot specimens to appropriate containers. Enter blood culture bottles on the blood culture instrumentation. Answer the telephone, triage calls appropriately, take appropriate messages; review pending logs; locate samples for add on orders; look up patient reports on computer and give results to clinicians where appropriate. Assists in the Reception/Triage area of the Lab, as needed. Order tests in the LIS. Contact nursing units or physician’s offices to verify confusing incomplete or confusing orders or sample problems. Under the direct observation of the Clinical Laboratory Scientist, set up and load tests on instruments or procedures as determined by the section lead. Under the direct observation of the Clinical Laboratory Scientist, perform limited function checks and preventative maintenance on instruments and equipment. Take inventory of reagents and supplies and restock when needed; put away supplies as they are received. Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Knowledge and ability to use medical terminology, preferred.
Excellent professional communication and interpersonal skills are essential.

Sharp HealthCare is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability or any other protected class
